# YaBiso Frontend - Backend API Integration Guide

## 🔗 API Base URL

**Development:**
```
http://localhost:8000/api/v1
```

**Production:**
```
https://yourdomain.com/api/v1
```

---

## 🔐 Authentication

### Headers Required
```javascript
{
  "Authorization": "Bearer <access_token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "X-Request-ID": "<request_id>"  // Optional, auto-generated by gateway
}
```

### Register User
```http
POST /auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "username": "username",
  "password": "SecurePass123!",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe"
}

Response (201):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "user-id",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "username": "username",
    "token": "eyJhbGc..."
  }
}
```

### Login User
```http
POST /auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "SecurePass123!"
}

Response (200):
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "refresh_token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 86400
}
```

### Refresh Token
```http
POST /auth/refresh
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "refresh_token": "eyJhbGc..."
}

Response (200):
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "refresh_token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 86400
}
```

### Get Current User
```http
GET /auth/me
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "id": "user-id",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "username": "username",
  "role": "buyer",
  "is_active": true,
  "mfa_enabled": false
}
```

## 📦 Products API

### List Products
```http
GET /products?page=1&per_page=20&category=electronics&search=laptop
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "product-1",
      "name": "Laptop",
      "price": 999.99,
      "discount_price": null,
      "rating": 4.5,
      "reviews_count": 120,
      "image_url": "https://...",
      "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total": 150,
    "total_pages": 8,
    "has_next": true,
    "has_previous": false
  }
}
```

### Get Product Details
```http
GET /products/{product_id}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "product-1",
    "name": "Laptop",
    "slug": "laptop",
    "description": "High performance laptop...",
    "price": 999.99,
    "rating": 4.5,
    "reviews_count": 120,
    "quantity": 50,
    "category_id": "cat-1",
    "images": ["https://...", "https://..."],
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Search Products
```http
GET /products/search?q=laptop&min_price=500&max_price=1500&rating_min=4
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "product-1",
      "name": "Laptop",
      "price": 999.99,
      "rating": 4.5,
      "image_url": "https://..."
    }
  ],
  "filters": {
    "query": "laptop",
    "price_range": [500, 1500],
    "rating_min": 4
  }
}
```

### Create Product Review
```http
POST /products/{product_id}/reviews
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "rating": 5,
  "title": "Great product!",
  "comment": "Excellent quality and fast shipping."
}

Response (201):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "review-1",
    "product_id": "product-1",
    "user_id": "user-1",
    "rating": 5,
    "title": "Great product!",
    "comment": "Excellent quality and fast shipping.",
    "created_at": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

## 💳 Payments API

### Initiate Payment
```http
POST /payments/initiate
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "order_id": "order-123",
  "amount": 99.99,
  "currency": "USD",
  "method": "stripe",
  "description": "Order #123"
}

Response (201):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "payment_id": "pay-1",
    "order_id": "order-123",
    "amount": 99.99,
    "status": "pending",
    "payment_url": "https://checkout.stripe.com/pay/..."
  }
}
```

### Get Payment Status
```http
GET /payments/{payment_id}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "pay-1",
    "order_id": "order-123",
    "amount": 99.99,
    "status": "completed",
    "method": "stripe",
    "created_at": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z",
    "completed_at": "2024-01-15T00:05:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Payment Methods (Stripe)
```http
GET /payments/stripe/payment-methods
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "pm_1234567890",
      "type": "card",
      "card": {
        "brand": "visa",
        "last4": "4242"
      },
      "created": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Request Refund
```http
POST /payments/refunds
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "payment_id": "pay-1",
  "amount": null,  // null = full refund
  "reason": "Customer requested"
}

Response (201):
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "ref-1",
    "payment_id": "pay-1",
    "amount": 99.99,
    "status": "pending",
    "created_at": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

## ⚙️ Frontend Setup

### Install Dependencies
```bash
npm install axios
```

### Configure API Client
```javascript
// src/api/client.js
import axios from 'axios';

const API_BASE_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1';

const client = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
});

// Add token to requests
client.interceptors.request.use(config => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// Handle token refresh on 401
client.interceptors.response.use(
  response => response,
  async error => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refresh_token');
      if (refreshToken) {
        try {
          const response = await axios.post(`${API_BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, {
            refresh_token: refreshToken
          });
          localStorage.setItem('access_token', response.data.access_token);
          return client.request(error.config);
        } catch (err) {
          // Redirect to login
          window.location.href = '/login';
        }
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default client;
```

### Example Usage
```javascript
// src/services/authService.js
import client from './client';

export const authService = {
  register: (data) => client.post('/auth/register', data),
  login: (data) => client.post('/auth/login', data),
  getCurrentUser: () => client.get('/auth/me'),
  logout: () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('access_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh_token');
  }
};

// src/services/productsService.js
export const productsService = {
  list: (params) => client.get('/products', { params }),
  get: (id) => client.get(`/products/${id}`),
  search: (query) => client.get('/products/search', { params: { q: query } })
};

// Usage in component
import { authService, productsService } from './services';

function LoginPage() {
  const handleLogin = async (email, password) => {
    try {
      const response = await authService.login({ email, password });
      localStorage.setItem('access_token', response.data.access_token);
      localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', response.data.refresh_token);
      // Redirect to dashboard
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Login failed:', error.response?.data);
    }
  };
  
  return (
    // JSX
  );
}
```

## 🔄 Error Handling

### Common Error Responses

**400 Bad Request**
```json
{
  "status_code": 400,
  "error": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "detail": "Invalid email format",
  "path": "/auth/register",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**401 Unauthorized**
```json
{
  "status_code": 401,
  "error": "AUTHENTICATION_ERROR",
  "detail": "Invalid token",
  "path": "/products",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**403 Forbidden**
```json
{
  "status_code": 403,
  "error": "AUTHORIZATION_ERROR",
  "detail": "Insufficient permissions",
  "path": "/admin/users",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**404 Not Found**
```json
{
  "status_code": 404,
  "error": "NOT_FOUND",
  "detail": "Product not found: prod-123",
  "path": "/products/prod-123",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**429 Too Many Requests**
```json
{
  "status_code": 429,
  "error": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
  "detail": "Rate limit exceeded",
  "path": "/products",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**500 Internal Server Error**
```json
{
  "status_code": 500,
  "error": "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR",
  "detail": "An unexpected error occurred",
  "path": "/products",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

## 🔄 Rate Limiting

**Default Limits:**
- 100 requests per 60 seconds per IP

**Headers:**
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 95
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1705310460
```

## 🧪 Testing API Endpoints

### Using cURL
```bash
# Register
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "username": "testuser",
    "password": "SecurePass123!",
    "first_name": "Test",
    "last_name": "User"
  }'

# Login
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "SecurePass123!"
  }'

# List Products
curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products?page=1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```

### Using Postman
1. Import OpenAPI spec (auto-generated at `/docs`)
2. Set environment variable: `{{api_url}}` = `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`
3. Create auth flow: Register → Login → Use token

### API Documentation
- **Swagger UI**: http://localhost:8000/docs
- **ReDoc**: http://localhost:8000/redoc
- **OpenAPI JSON**: http://localhost:8000/openapi.json

## 🚀 Deployment

### Environment Variables (.env)
```
REACT_APP_API_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com/api/v1
REACT_APP_ENV=production
REACT_APP_LOG_LEVEL=warn
```

### CORS Configuration
- Frontend: `https://yourdomain.com`
- API Gateway accepts from configured CORS_ORIGINS
